en_title: Cookie Texture Plate: Hearts, Flowers, and Stars
en_subtitle: 3D printing to order
en_description:
12 × 12 cm plate to press onto fondant, cookies, or clay.

How to use: flatten the dough or clay (thickness guides keep it even), dust on a little starch or release agent, and press the plate down. The design is mirrored so it reads the right way round on the finished piece.

  • Part dimensions: 120 × 120 × 4 mm
  • Printed in 3D to order by the shop you choose: material, color, price, and lead time depend on its offer.

For food (fondant, cookies): ask for a food-safe material and hand wash it; PLA and ABS are not dishwasher safe.

Have a 3D printer? Download the file for free and change the text or dimensions in the HETNA tool.
